newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait National Bank welcomes IBCA rating.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait National Bank welcomes IBCA rating.

text.p: National Bank of Kuwait (NBK) said on Tuesday it was proud to have been awarded the European credit rating agency IBCA's A/B individual rating.
"We are proud of the new rating," Mohammad al-Bahr, NBK's chairman, said in a statement. "It shows the confidence and respect NBK enjoys internationally."
IBCA said on Monday it has upgraded NBK's individual rating to A/B from B and affirmed its other ratings at BBB+ long-term, A2 short term and a legal of two.
"This (rating) displays the financial strength and the excellent performance of our bank," Bahr added.
NBK, Kuwait's largest commercial bank, reported a mid-year net profit rise of 11 percent to 39.19 million dinars ($128.5 million).
